title: # `image_default_format` is documented but has no consumer
body:
### Issue Description

`containers.conf` documents `image_default_format` as applying to pulls, pushes and builds:

> **image_default_format**="oci"|"v2s2"|"v2s1"
>
> Manifest Type (oci, v2s2, or v2s1) to use when pulling, pushing, building container images. By default images pulled and pushed match the format of the source image. Building/committing defaults to OCI.

Setting it has no observable effect, and the field appears to have no consumer anywhere:

| source | references to `ImageDefaultFormat` outside `vendor/` |
| --- | --- |
| containers/common v0.62.2 (vendored by podman v5.8.4) | struct field + doc comment only, `pkg/config/config.go:362-366` |
| podman v5.8.4 | none |
| buildah (main, 2026-09-10) | none |

The deprecated sibling `ImageBuildFormat` has no consumer either. By contrast the `BUILDAH_FORMAT` environment variable *is* read (`buildah pkg/cli/common.go:519`, `cmd/buildah/common.go:194`), which is the mechanism that actually changes the built image format — so the config option looks like the declarative equivalent of a working env var, and silently is not.

Note that `libimage/pull.go` in containers/common, which implements the pull, makes no reference to a manifest type at all.

The option appears to have been born without a consumer rather than regressed into one. It was added in containers/common d0c205ff (2021-01-28), whose diff touches only `docs/containers.conf.5.md`, `pkg/config/config.go`, `pkg/config/containers.conf` and tests, and whose commit message states the intent: *"This PR adds image_default_format to define the format to be used by all tools create/building/pulling and pusing images."* The consuming side does not appear to have landed since: neither the field name nor the `image_default_format` config key occurs outside `vendor/` in podman v1.9.3, v2.0.6, v2.2.1, v3.4.4, v4.9.5 or v5.8.4, or in buildah v1.23.1 or main.


### Steps to reproduce the issue

Any image whose config blob is `application/vnd.oci.image.config.v1+json`.

```console
$ cat ~/.config/containers/containers.conf
[engine]
image_default_format="v2s2"

$ podman rmi -f $IMAGE ; podman pull $IMAGE

$ podman image inspect $IMAGE --format '{{.ManifestType}}'
application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json          # expected: docker v2s2
```

An invalid value (`image_default_format="bogus"`) is accepted just as silently, consistent with the field never being consumed or validated.

### Describe the results you received

The pulled image keeps the source (OCI) manifest type. No warning, no error.

### Describe the results you expected

Two possible resolutions and they are different kinds of work:

- **Documentation fix:** drop "pulling, pushing" (and possibly the option itself) from the `containers.conf` man page and the struct comment, or mark it as not implemented. This is a defect today — the documentation promises behaviour that no code provides.
- **Implementation:** wire the setting up in the engines, as the original commit intended. That is a feature that was never written, not a regression. The upside with this is that it could mitigate #18904 and related tickets.

A documented option that no code reads is worse than an absent one, because it is a plausible-looking fix that fails silently.

Note on where this belongs: the documentation and the struct field now live in the monorepo at `common/pkg/config/config.go` (module `go.podman.io/common`, formerly containers/common), while any implementation would be in podman and/or buildah. Filed here because that is where the behaviour is observed; happy for it to be moved.


### podman info output

```yaml
Version:      5.8.4
API Version:  5.8.4
Go Version:   go1.26.4
Built:        Fri Jun 26 02:00:00 2026
Build Origin: Fedora Project
OS/Arch:      linux/amd64

Package: `podman-5.8.4-1.fc44.x86_64` on Fedora 44, rootless. skopeo 1.22.2.
```

### Podman in a container

No

### Privileged Or Rootless

Rootless

### Upstream Latest Release

No

### Additional environment details

_No response_

### Additional information

This surfaced while looking for a supported way to work around #18904 / #25454: a Docker `Healthcheck` written into an OCI-mediatype config (what BuildKit produces once provenance attestations are on, i.e. by default) is present in the config blob but is not surfaced by podman, so the container has no health state. Converting the image to `v2s2` recovers it:

```console
$ skopeo copy --format v2s2 docker://$IMAGE containers-storage:$IMAGE
$ podman image inspect $IMAGE --format '{{json .Config.Healthcheck}}'
{"Test":["CMD-SHELL","<the image's health command>"],"Interval":1000000000,"Timeout":1000000000,"Retries":5}
```

Since containers/image can do the conversion, `image_default_format=v2s2` reads like the configuration-level version of that workaround.

- Reproduced through the CLI and through the service API endpoint `POST /v1.41/images/create` (the path Testcontainers and other Docker API clients use), with `podman.socket` restarted after writing the config so the service read it.
- Config read from `~/.config/containers/containers.conf` (rootless).
- Reproduced on 5.8.4, the current version in the Fedora 44 repository. Not retested on 6.x, but no release note between 5.8.2 and 6.1.1 mentions this setting, and the source references above were checked at podman v5.8.4 and buildah main.
